svg.title: Fastener pockets in the eight-mount proposal
svg.desc: Plan sections compare rotor clamping pockets and guide tracks to the upper and lower carrier recesses. Below them are minimum material thicknesses and the bearing-pilot detail.
svg.text: SIMPLE DOUBLE BEARING / EIGHT-MOUNT PROPOSAL
Clearance around the recessed fasteners
Three face views at independent scales. Red segments mark the shortest wall between the fastener recess and the adjacent hole.
Cycloidal disc
Opposing clamshell faces overlaid
Upper carrier cap
Six socket-head counterbores
Lower carrier cap
Six nut pockets and roof reliefs
2.41 mm · nut side
Purple nut relief to teal Ø10.3 guide track.
Head side: 2.54 mm from the Ø7.12 recess.
1.80 mm · head side
Teal Ø6.2 counterbore to amber Ø3.6 mount bore.
The embedded mount nut sits in the core.
1.29 mm · nut side
Purple relief to amber Ø3.6 mount bore.
Hex socket and overhang steps included.
The thinner wall is at the carrier pilot
At the stepped split face, a Ø3.6 mounting bore passes only 0.12 mm outside the Ø29.7 pilot socket (dashed circle).
The pilot socket and the deeper mounting-nut pockets are in different pieces. The 0.12 mm is a local plastic sliver in the cap.
Nominal dimensions in mm • 20:1, 1.5 mm eccentricity • Eight-mount layout study; production CAD still uses four mounts per carrier.
